title: cacalia psilophylla
intro: Cacalia psilophylla, commonly known as the "Chinese button snakeroot," is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia psilophylla include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Cacalia psilophylla include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
